drivers: Houthi attack claim on Ras Tanura refinery; US Gulf storm shut-ins
Heavy oil glut in the Americas from freight squeeze
Petcoke rally pushing buyers toward coal
outlooks.summary: Headlines are mixed: refinery and storm disruptions are bullish, but a heavy-oil glut in the Americas and coal switching are bearish. Price is down 16% over 3 months and the supply-pressure score is near zero.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch whether the Ras Tanura attack caused real output loss and how long US Gulf shut-ins last.
outlooks.summary_zh: 消息面多空交织:炼厂和风暴扰动偏多,但美洲重油过剩及向煤炭转换偏空。价格三个月下跌16%,供应压力评分接近零。
drivers_zh: 胡塞武装声称袭击拉斯坦努拉炼厂;美国墨西哥湾因风暴停产
运费上涨导致美洲重油过剩
石油焦价格上涨促使买家转向煤炭
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注拉斯坦努拉袭击是否造成实际产量损失,以及美国墨西哥湾停产持续多久。

drivers: Fed rate hike fears and strong dollar
Gold down sharply from record high
ETF outflows
outlooks.summary: The story is macro-driven, not supply-driven. No supply-shortage headlines, and prices are falling on rate fears, so a shortage-led price rise looks unlikely.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch US inflation data and Fed rate signals.
outlooks.summary_zh: 当前由宏观因素而非供应驱动。没有供应短缺类消息,价格因加息担忧下跌,因短缺推动上涨的可能性较低。
drivers_zh: 美联储加息担忧与美元走强
金价较历史高点大幅回落
ETF资金流出
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注美国通胀数据和美联储利率信号。

drivers: DRC suspends all cobalt exports from 30 Nov
Four-month export ban to counter oversupply
Price jumped 33% ahead of the ban
outlooks.summary: The DRC, the top producer, is reimposing a four-month export ban. The price has already jumped, but the ban removes a large share of supply, so further upside is likely over 1-3 months.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch ARECOMS ban implementation, any quota details, and stock levels in China.
outlooks.summary_zh: 主要生产国刚果(金)将重新实施为期四个月的出口禁令。价格已大幅上涨,但禁令将切断大量供应,未来1-3个月仍有上行空间。
drivers_zh: 刚果(金)自11月30日起暂停所有钴出口
为应对过剩实施四个月出口禁令
禁令前价格已上涨33%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注ARECOMS禁令的执行情况、配额细则以及中国库存水平。

drivers: Oyu Tolgoi exports cut 70% by China border checks
China extends suspension of export ban to US
Mostly generic metals headlines
outlooks.summary: Few headlines are specific to molybdenum. Border-check disruption is supportive, but the China export pause is easing. Price is already up 18% in 3 months.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch whether Mongolia–China border flows recover.
outlooks.summary_zh: 针对钼的消息很少。边境检查造成的扰动有支撑作用,但中国出口禁令暂停有所缓和。价格三个月已上涨18%。
drivers_zh: 中国边境检查使奥尤陶勒盖出口下降70%
中国延长对美出口禁令暂停期
多为泛金属类消息
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注蒙古至中国边境货运是否恢复。

drivers: CATL Jianxiawo restart could ease supply
Zimbabwe raw lithium export ban hits processing roadblock
China extends export-ban suspension
outlooks.summary: Signals offset each other: the Jianxiawo restart is bearish, while Zimbabwe's processing problems are mildly bullish. Price is down 13% over 3 months.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the pace of CATL Jianxiawo's restart.
outlooks.summary_zh: 信号相互抵消:枝附窝矿复产偏空,津巴布韦加工受阻略偏多。价格三个月下跌13%。
drivers_zh: 宁德时代枝附窝矿复产或缓解供应担忧
津巴布韦原锂出口禁令遇加工瓶颈
中国延长出口禁令暂停期
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注宁德时代枝附窝矿复产进度。

drivers: China expands rare earth export controls
Thailand to ban export of mining chemicals to Myanmar
Price up 36% over 12 months
outlooks.summary: Tighter Chinese controls and Thailand's planned chemical ban could cut Myanmar rare earth output. Price is up but only 4% in 3 months, so there is room for more upside.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the start date of Thailand's ban and any Chinese licensing changes.
outlooks.summary_zh: 中国收紧管制,加上泰国拟禁止化学品出口,可能削减缅甸稀土产出。价格三个月仅涨4%,仍有上行空间。
drivers_zh: 中国扩大稀土出口管制
泰国拟禁止向缅甸出口采矿化学品
价格12个月上涨36%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注泰国禁令生效日期及中国许可政策变化。

drivers: Congo conflict and Indonesia cuts squeeze supply
Oyu Tolgoi export cuts
Price up 56% over 12 months
outlooks.summary: Supply is tight from Congo and Indonesia. Much of this is priced in after a 56% annual rise, but a flat 3-month price suggests some further upside risk.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Indonesian export volumes and Congo mine disruptions.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果(金)和印尼供应紧张。年内涨幅达56%,部分已被计入价格,但三个月价格持平,仍有一定上行风险。
drivers_zh: 刚果(金)冲突和印尼减产造成供应紧张
奥尤陶勒盖出口下降
价格12个月上涨56%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注印尼出口量和刚果(金)矿山扰动。

drivers: Major Chinese antimony mine halts production
China extends export ban pause to January 27
Price down 56% over 12 months
outlooks.summary: A mine halt is bullish, but the extended export pause and a weak price trend limit the upside. Evidence is mixed.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch how long the Chinese mine stays shut and the pause expiry in January.
outlooks.summary_zh: 矿山停产偏多,但出口暂停延期及价格弱势限制上行空间。证据好坏参半。
drivers_zh: 中国一大型锑矿停产
中国将出口禁令暂停期延至1月27日
价格12个月下跌56%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注该矿停产时长以及1月暂停期到期情况。

drivers: Price up 67% in 3 months
China extends suspension of restrictions on US
Tight AI-driven indium phosphide demand
outlooks.summary: China's reprieve eases near-term policy risk, and much of the rise is priced in after a 67% gain. Tight demand and licensing still leave some upside risk.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch for a Chinese policy move when the suspension ends in January 2027.
outlooks.summary_zh: 中国暂缓限制缓解了短期政策风险,且价格已上涨67%,部分利好已被消化。需求紧张和许可要求仍带来一定上行风险。
drivers_zh: 价格三个月上涨67%
中国延长对美限制暂停期
人工智能带动磷化铟需求紧张
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注2027年1月暂停期结束时中国的政策动向。

drivers: Houthi attack claim on Ras Tanura refinery; US Gulf storm shut-ins
Heavy oil glut in the Americas
Petcoke rally brings coal switching closer
outlooks.summary: Disruptions are bullish, but a heavy-oil glut and coal switching offset them. The price is up 15% and the supply-pressure score is near zero.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Gulf Coast refinery output after the storm and any Saudi supply loss.
outlooks.summary_zh: 扰动因素偏多,但重油过剩和转用煤炭对冲。价格已涨15%,供应压力评分接近零。
drivers_zh: 胡塞武装声称袭击拉斯坦努拉炼厂;美国墨西哥湾因风暴停产
美洲重油过剩
石油焦上涨使转用煤炭临近
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注风暴后墨西哥湾沿岸炼厂产量及沙特供应是否受损。

drivers: Houthi attack claim on Ras Tanura refinery; US Gulf storm shut-ins
Heavy oil glut in the Americas
Coal switching risk
outlooks.summary: Signals are mixed and the supply-pressure score is near zero. The price is down 5% over 3 months after a large 12-month rise.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch refinery restarts and storm impacts on US Gulf output.
outlooks.summary_zh: 信号好坏参半,供应压力评分接近零。价格在12个月大涨后,三个月下跌5%。
drivers_zh: 胡塞武装声称袭击拉斯坦努拉炼厂;美国墨西哥湾因风暴停产
美洲重油过剩
转用煤炭的风险
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注炼厂复产及风暴对美国墨西哥湾产量的影响。
